We want his quiet resting expression. Make the mouth ONE CONTINUOUS SOLID STRAIGHT HORIZONTAL BAR, no visible segmentation or gaps, no illuminated blocks. Its width should be about FIVE times the width of one eye; its thickness exactly ONE-HALF the height of one eye. Compared with the current thin mouth line, this means slightly thicker and about 50 percent longer. Make this whole bar very faint dark green, as if green LED lights are at 10 percent brightness, not glowing. At rest it is just a subtle full-width straight mouth baseline. No active talking highlight. No smile, lips or waveform. Keep the existing eye brightness unchanged. Do not add any text or modify the robot or background.
note: Static art interpretation of the resting mouth. Exact pixel geometry and alpha remain implemented by src/meeting-room/synergy-display.js in animated scenes.
